verdict.rationale: Foreloop has some built-in agentic help: its own agent reads a feedback submission, fills in the intention, and proposes tasks, and it runs automatic product reviews on pull requests that you can re-trigger with "@foreloop retest". The actual work, though, is delegated to an external agent (Claude Code or Codex) that you run on your own machine, which claims approved tasks via the CLI or MCP. So there is no in-product assistant that carries tasks through to completion. missing for 10: a built-in assistant that executes delegated tasks inside the product, a conversational or ad-hoc delegation interface, independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in agent's behavior.
